title: Murex Consultant
summary: Configures, integrates and supports Murex or Calypso, the trading and risk platforms banks use for derivatives, FX and bond trades. Works in a bank's technology team or an IT services firm, between trading desks, operations and the platform vendor.
dailyDuties: Build and fix MxML or Calypso interfaces with upstream and downstream systems
Set up datamart extractions and reports for risk and finance users
Investigate trade and end-of-day batch issues with SQL and Unix tools
Gather requirements from desk and operations users and write specs
Test platform upgrades and changes with business users

skills.expectation: Configure and support Murex MX.3, such as MxML interfaces, datamart reports or trade workflows
Configure and customise Calypso engines, workflows and trade processing
Know how derivatives, FX and fixed income trades move from capture to settlement
Understand bank treasury, front-office and back-office operations
Write SQL on Oracle or Sybase to investigate trades and build reports
Work on Unix or Linux servers where the platform runs
Read and transform XML messages with XSLT for platform interfaces
Gather requirements from trading, risk and operations users and write functional specs
Work with desk users, operations and vendor teams on changes and upgrades
Understand VaR, sensitivities and P&L reports
Automate end-of-day checks with shell scripts
Run end-of-day batches in Control-M or similar
Write Java extensions, mainly for Calypso
Test changes with business users before release

groups.label: A capital markets platform (Murex or Calypso)
